answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 156961 Country: India Title: I miss my Fajr prayer Question: I wanted to know that I sleep at late at night because I don’t get sleep early so I am not able to wake up for Fajr. So missing Fajr prayer in such condition will it be considered as mistake? And I also wanted to know what should I do to seek forgiveness as I have been missing my Fajr salah continuously from one week? Answer ID: 156961 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 383/309/B=3/1439) This practice of yours is not good. You should go to bed early immediately after Isha salah and sleep with the intention of offering Fajr salah with jamah, you shall get up in time in-shaAllah. You should also keep on doing true taubah and istighfar. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
